flow.name: axn-term - devin restore with extra window
flow.description: Verify devin session restore is not broken when a second window is also open on restore.

step.description: Create temp state with an extra window
Run the devin session in the main window
Close axn-term so both windows are persisted

assert.description: The app closed and saved state

step.description: Reopen and verify both windows come back with the correct session

assert.description: The correct devin session is restored with both windows
The correct devin session is restored with both windows
